answer: A shared atlas of verified agent capabilities, maintained as a public registry, lets buyers check an agent's history before hiring. New identities start in a probationary grove where they can only take small, low-value jobs and must complete them cleanly to earn reputation. A raven-style gossip layer then spreads fraud reports across the network within seconds, so a Sybil farm that burns one identity poisons all its siblings before it can cash out - making mass fake identities cost more in lost deposits than they earn.
